title: ANATOMY OF THE LAST MILE (source-verified) + S35C CROSS-CHECK: the terminal face (H, inf) x (0, gaoD0max] is NOT body-closable for a structural reason, and its closure is the DUAL of two programs - (a) the DATA program: the E1-clause fill certificates |zeta(rho)| >= devProg(rho) at each off-pair zero (hPT = the on-line record growing height by height; E1Clause/E1ClauseV3 pointwise above the data frontier; the S1Marg margin track), and (b) the STRUCTURAL program: a zero-free input whose d0-edge advances gaoD0max = 0.3748087 toward 0 (the tracker race, conveyor demonstrated). The face is the exact territory where neither yet reaches. S35C (tmp/s35c_face_shaping.py, 50-dps, 29x25 face grid): the S1vsS3 sandwich ratio r_l = devProg/(Bwire+MrLift) is T-INVARIANT to 4 digits over 9 orders of magnitude in t (1.11355343 at t=1e3 -> 1.11355287 at t>=1e4), grows quadratically in d0 (log10 r from 0.047 to 3.796 = exactly (0.3748/0.005)^2 in d0), and crosses 1 at d0 ~ 0.004738 - the SAME line as the program's own day033 sharp edge S4Strip.r2prime = 47384091/10^10 = 0.0047384091, because floProg/mown and devProg are the same own-mass object (s4StripUnifiedFloor: squeeze and S2 floor are ONE object on the strip) and the n4 wire is t^-2 while dev ~ d0^2 t^-2: same crossing line, independently re-derived. WHY the face cannot be body-closed (the wall, stated precisely): the terminal endpoint (B15, rh_program78_stripfront_mach_unifiedGao) takes an ARBITRARY Qside : R x R -> R and discharges the P1.2 legs hs1 (Qside >= devProg - MfP at off-pairs), hs2 (in body: s2ActualFullBand), hs3 (Qside <= BwireR + MrLift at off-pairs), S4-covered/low/far (in body: s4asm sharp r2prime edge + hX pin + offPairFarEmpty from [Z78G]). The Qside legs are GOALS of the refine, not premises - they cannot contradict each other, and no body fact (S2: dev >= flo; S4: wire < flo; the 1.1135 sandwich - all comparisons of EXPLICIT FUNCTIONS, independent of zero existence) refutes a hypothetical off-pair zero at d0 <= gaoD0max: [Z78G] only BOUNDS d0 <= gaoD0max, and the window band (0, 0.005) sits at Re in (1/2, 0.505) - FAR below the 0.8748087 frontier, in the territory where NO unconditional zero-free result reaches (classical zero-free is 1 - c/log t, a RIGHT-side region; the race attacks the same band from the right). For the ACTUAL zero set with Qside = the |zeta| fill, hs1 AT a zero reads |zeta(rho)| = 0 >= devProg(rho) > 0 - a contradiction - which is exactly why hs1 IS the zero-exclusion and exactly why it needs the fill DATA (E1 clauses) to be discharged pointwise. THE LAST MILE, QUANTIFIED: face width in d0 = 0.3748087 (frontier edge) - the structural program must advance 0.3698087 more in d0 (frontier 0.8748087 -> 1/2) to shrink it to 0; the data program must extend the certified fill/on-line record from the current data frontier through arbitrarily high heights - which no finite data grind alone can finish (heights unbounded): the FINAL solution needs the structural input to reach the LINE (or the window band (0, 0.005) specifically, the last 1.33% of the face width, where the sandwich t-invariance 1.1135 shows the explicit-function machinery is T-UNIFORM and decays no further - the cleanest structural target). No in-tree change this unit, no RH claim; the s35c map is a t-uniformity cross-check of the r2prime edge with certified-grid precision, recorded for the margin ledger.
body:
## The wall, stated precisely (from the Lean source, read today)

B15 terminal endpoint (formal/RhAttack/RHEnd.lean, rh_program78_stripfront_mach_unifiedGao): inputs = [Z78G] + hqz + honline + q + Qside (arbitrary) + H (>= 1000) + hPT (WinC.allOnLineUpTo q H, the on-line record) + hOffG (the face: H <= t0, 0 < d0 <= gaoD0max, no off-pair): conclusion RH q. Discharge of the six P1.2 legs:
- S2 (hs2): IN BODY - s2ActualFullBand (FloorUnif) on (1000, inf) x (0, 1/2]; low band vacuous below H (hPT); far d0 > 1/2: offPairFarEmpty from [Z78] (derived from [Z78G]).
- S4 covered/low/far: low vacuous (hPT); far offPairFarEmpty; covered above H: killed by the face today - the body content (s4asm_S4_on_pairs_sharp, day033, edge S4Strip.r2prime = 0.0047384091, window branch d-independent near pin under the hX pin S4W.Xwire S4W.T0 <= S4W.RX) EXISTS and is available.
- S1 (hs1) and S3 (hs3): the Qside legs - goals of the refine, for ARBITRARY Qside. hs1 at a point = Qside(t0,d0) >= devProg(t0,d0) - MfP (= devProg, MfP = 0); hs3 = Qside <= BwireR + MrLift (Mr := fun p => MrLift p.1 p.2 in B15; BwireR = Z78P12.BwireP = S4A.BwireR: strip branch p8_B(t, n4(t)) on [1/200, 1/2], window branches p8_B at floor(13t/8) / nGrow below).

The wall: to fill hs1 on the strip in body would require, for ANY Qside, Qside >= devProg at off-pairs - impossible (Qside arbitrary); and the 'sandwich contradiction' reading (hs1 + hs3 jointly inconsistent where dev >= wire) does NOT discharge the legs, because the legs are sibling GOALS, not co-premises - the engine rh_from_regime_closures takes all six as premises and derives RH, but the endpoint must SUPPLY each premise separately, and ex falso at a hypothetical off-pair needs a body refutation of 'off-pair at (t0, d0 <= gaoD0max)', which no explicit-function fact (S2, S4, the sandwich - all zero-existence-independent) provides. LowExcl-type joint-contradiction logic works only in shapes where the contradictory legs are co-premises of ONE theorem about the data (the B2-era low-band shape with the hS2low data premise) - not in the B15 face shape.

## The duality (what actually shrinks the face)

(1) DATA: for the actual zero set, Qside = |zeta| fill; hs1 at a zero = 0 >= devProg > 0, so hs1 discharged at a point = a certificate that NO zero has a fill below the detector floor there. The program: hPT grows the on-line record (allOnLineUpTo q H - t < H killed outright); E1Clause/E1ClauseV3 (q 7000 above G) certify fill vs devProg pointwise in the face territory per the program ledger; the S1Marg track is the measured margin of the fill program (25 certified candidates >= 1 in class to 2.8e7; first exploratory dip below 1 at 3.1e7). This grinds the face DOWN in height as H (record) grows - but heights are unbounded: no finite data grind finishes.
(2) STRUCTURAL: a zero-free input with stronger d0-edge (frontier race: [Z78] 0.875 -> [Z78L] 0.874957019420098947 -> [Z78T] 0.8748436 -> [Z78G] 0.8748087 -> [Z78C-pending] 0.8747729897 on merge -> ...). Each record closes a slice of the face in body (offPairD0le*: the new stronger bound), demonstrated mechanically by the B6 conveyor. The structural program must advance 0.3698087 in d0 more (frontier to 1/2) to shrink the face to width 0. NO unconditional zero-free result reaches the window band Re in (1/2, 0.505): classical theory gives 1 - c/log t (a right-side region); the race and the face attack the same band, the face from the left.

## S35C: the t-uniformity cross-check (empirical core of this unit)

Grid: t in [1e3, 3.1e12] (29 log-spaced, x~4.64 per step), d0 in [1/200, 0.3748087] (25 log-spaced), 50-dps detector (tmp/s35c_face_shaping.py, reusing the exact s35b ports of the named Lean definitions). Result:
- r_l(t, d0) = devStripMin(t, d0) / (p8_B(t, n4(t)) + MrLift(t, d0)) >= 1.11355 at every grid point (MIN 1.113552873 at d0 = 1/200, t >= 1e4; MAX 6257.3 at (1000, 0.3748)).
- T-INVARIANCE: the t-rows are identical to 4 significant figures (1.11355343 at t = 1e3 vs 1.11355288 at t = 1e4 vs 1.11355287 for t >= 1e5): both dev ~ C d0^2 t^-2 and the n4 wire ~ C' t^-2 (n4 = ceil(3.1e7 t^4) so p8_B ~ C' t^-2 exactly) are 1/t^2 objects - the ratio is t^0 to leading order. The explicit-function machinery of the strip is T-UNIFORM: it neither decays nor grows with height - the same margin 1.1135 at 1e3 and at 3e12.
- D0-QUADRATIC: log10 r_l sweeps 0.047 -> 3.796 across the grid = exactly 2 log10(0.3748087/0.005) (ratio of d0 squares) - dev is quadratic in d0 to leading order (the straddle ratio Rratio - 1 ~ O(d0^2)).
- CROSSING: r_l = 1 at d0 = 1/sqrt(C) with C = 1.11355 x (1/200)^2 -> d0* = 200/sqrt(1.11355) / 200 x... = 0.0047376 - matching (within grid precision and the 4-digit ratio) the program's own day033 sharp edge S4Strip.r2prime = 47384091/10^10 = 0.0047384091 (S4Asm section 7: the d-edge of the strip branch moves from 1/200 to r2prime; the window branch's near pin is d-independent so its edge moves along). The coincidence is structural, not accidental: floProg on the strip = floStripMin = the own-mass object = the same object devProg is a minimum of (s4StripUnifiedFloor: 'the squeeze and the S2 floor are ONE object on 1/200 <= d0 <= 1/2'), and the n4 wire is t^-2 while dev ~ d0^2 t^-2 - both comparisons (S2-vs-S4 floor side, S1-vs-S3 sandwich side) cross where d0^2 C = C', i.e. the same line.
- Ledger value: the sandwich margin 1.1135 is the CERTIFIED-GRID-precision floor of the strip's explicit-function slack - the quantity the window-band structural target must beat (a closure of (0, 0.005) would need the comparison to hold on the WINDOW wire branch, where p8_B at the floor(13t/8)/nGrow schedules is ~1e8 LARGER than the n4 wire - the sandwich there is ~2e-10, not 1.1135 - so the window band is NOT a sandwich target; it is a pure zero-free/data territory, and its 0.005 width = 1.33% of the face = the last structural target of the race).

## What this means for the Final Solution map

- The in-tree proof skeleton to [Z78G] stands at 100% (unchanged); the face is the residue exactly as 0111/0149 said, now with the precise wall anatomy (arbitrary-Qside leg goals; explicit-function facts zero-existence-independent; window band structurally bare of classical zero-free information).
- Forward lines, in priority: (1) the conveyor (gated on PR#69 merge - the d0-edge step 0.8748087 -> 0.8747729897, shrink 3.57e-5; pre-staged); (2) the structural race toward 1/2 - the long game, each cycle closing a slice; the NEXT cycle after 0148 lands in [0.874561, 0.874773) per 0147, closed-by-provenance (frozen certificate tables, AI-assisted search not shipped); (3) the data program (E1-clause fill certificates): the S1Marg dip at 3.1e7 is the current data frontier - extending the certified fill range is the height-by-height grind; (4) a NEW analytic species for the window band (Re in (1/2, 0.505)) - the only way to close the last 1.33% without waiting for the race: no such method is in the tree today, and none is claimed.
- No RH claim: the face remains a zero-exclusion statement in the unverified region; every input stays a named hypothesis; replays prove neither RH nor boundary nonvanishing.
